warnings: Last sanitary sheet (SN-10 of 10). It is the enlargement SN-04's channel callout points to ('รางระบายน้ำ คสล กว้าง 0.30ม ... ดูแบบขยาย') -- that cross-reference resolves.

*** TWO ALTERNATIVE COVERS ARE DETAILED AT THE SAME 0.39 x 0.50 x 0.075 SIZE: a steel grating and an RC slab. *** The sheet does not say which goes where, and SN-04's plan callout says only 'ฝาปิด คสล'. On that evidence the RC cover is the one used and the steel grating is an alternative -- but nothing states it, so both are recorded and neither is dropped.

THE CHANNEL SECTION IS FULLY SPECIFIED and is a real concrete quantity that the plans only hint at: 0.30 m clear width, 0.05 m walls, 0.39 m cover width, 0.10 m base slab over 0.10 m of water-compacted coarse sand, rendered smooth inside, reinforced Ø9@0.20 with Ø6 at not more than 0.20 and 3-Ø6 in the base.
CHANNEL DEPTH IS NOT A FIXED FIGURE -- it is marked 'ลึกตามแบบ / ตามระดับความลาด', i.e. set by the 1:200 fall from SN-04. Depth therefore varies along the run and cannot be taken as a single number.
The steel grating is 6x50 mm flat bars at 40 mm centres in a 6x75 mm frame -- countable if that option is taken.
